notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
Dear Adventurers,

I've heard that some of you found the initial challenge a bit too intense, so I've just rolled out an update to the demo based on your feedback: Options - Difficulty settings.

Easy Mode: Immerse yourself in the storyline with boosted health and mana, along with additional lives; perfect for those who prefer a more relaxed adventure.

Hard Mode: Brace yourself for tougher enemies and amped-up boss abilities that will truly test your gaming prowess.

Your feedback matters, so don't forget to share your thoughts on the community forums or social media.

Happy holidays!

Minami Chan
